EditorToolbar.tsx, AdminMode.tsx, ProductEditorModal.tsx: confirmed `const X = () => null; export default X;` — these are now truly inert and cannot render the old floating bar.

EditorContext.tsx read-only stub is fine; no mutator side-effects touch localStorage. Old pages that still call `useEditor()` will get default `{isEditing:false,isPreviewing:false}` and render plain children. No console warnings about this surfaced.

No residual imports of EditorToolbar/AdminMode/ProductEditorModal rendering the bar. Grep confirms they're imported but now render null.
(Nit) /app/frontend/src/components/editor/ still contains 7 legacy files. Once confident nothing imports them, these can be deleted entirely to avoid future confusion.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The preview host https://coding-walkthrough.preview.emergentagent.com is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile. Anonymous GETs to /, /products, /about, /cart all serve normally after a small delay, but the /login page shows a 'Verify you are human' challenge for headless browsers — that blocks automated JWT login. To exercise /admin end-to-end from automation, either (a) call POST /api/auth/login directly with requests to get a JWT and then inject it into localStorage before navigating to /admin, or (b) run tests against a non-Cloudflare-fronted URL. For this iteration, the anonymous-side regressions (the user's actual complaint) were fully verified and all pass. Screenshots: /app/.screenshots/home_anon2.png (clean home, no floating bar).
rca of the issue: No new bug. Original user complaint ('still seeing old admin modal') was caused by (1) EditorToolbar.tsx rendering a fixed-position 'Admin Only' toolbar on every page and (2) AdminMode.tsx being mounted from that toolbar. Both have been neutralized to `() => null` in the current code. Verified by DOM scan on 6 pages: no element with position:fixed contains 'Admin Only' / 'Edit Mode' / 'Preview Mode' / 'Editor' text; document.body.innerText contains none of those strings. Fix is correct and complete.
